social_security_withheld_cents.description: W-2 box 4, Social Security tax withheld. Required when ONE filer holds more than one W-2 — without it the excess Social Security credit resolves to zero however many employers there were, a silently wrong number. Refused when it exceeds the statutory rate on box 3, which is a caller-input fault the engine would otherwise turn into a knockout plus a fabricated credit.

medicare_withheld_cents.description: W-2 box 6, Medicare tax withheld. Optional; absent means the box is blank. Feeds Form 8959 Part IV: the amount above the regular 1.45% rate on box 5 is Additional Medicare Tax withholding (line 24), which reaches Form 1040 lines 25d and 33 as tax already paid.

dependent_care_benefits_cents.description: Form W-2 box 10, dependent care benefits. Optional; absent or 0 means the box is blank. Above 0 it opens Form 2441 Part III: this filer's dependent_care_plan_maximum_cents is then required and dependent_care_forfeited_cents is asked at the root; the benefit is excluded up to the least of the qualified expenses, the earned-income limit, the plan maximum, and the section 129 limit (5,000; 2,500 on a separate return), and the rest is taxed on Form 1040 line 1e. A joint return where both spouses report a benefit and either earned less than the care expenses is the engine's own knockout, served with words (the division of taxable benefits is not entered here).

box12_a_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code A — Uncollected social security or RRTA tax on tips. Optional; absent or 0 means no code A entry. Above 0 it is Schedule 2 line 13 (uncollected social security and Medicare or RRTA tax on tips or group-term life insurance), summed with the other three such codes into Form 1040 line 24.

box12_b_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code B — Uncollected Medicare tax on tips. Optional; absent or 0 means no code B entry. Above 0 it is Schedule 2 line 13 (uncollected social security and Medicare or RRTA tax on tips or group-term life insurance), summed with the other three such codes into Form 1040 line 24.

box12_c_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code C — Taxable cost of group-term life insurance over $50,000. Optional; absent or 0 means no code C entry. Carried to the engine; it moves no line this service serves at the pin (the DAG agrees).

box12_d_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code D — Elective deferrals under a section 401(k) cash or deferred arrangement plan. Optional; absent or 0 means no code D entry. Above 0 it is Form 8880 line 2 (the retirement savings contributions credit, Schedule 3 line 4): the filer's Form 8880 questions are then asked; measured 20% of 2,000 at 25,000 of wages.

box12_e_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code E — Elective deferrals under a section 403(b) salary reduction agreement. Optional; absent or 0 means no code E entry. Above 0 it is Form 8880 line 2 (the retirement savings contributions credit, Schedule 3 line 4): the filer's Form 8880 questions are then asked; measured 20% of 2,000 at 25,000 of wages.

box12_f_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code F — Elective deferrals under a section 408(k)(6) salary reduction SEP. Optional; absent or 0 means no code F entry. Above 0 it is a code the engine knocks a return out for, so the return is refused by name rather than computed without it.

box12_g_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code G — Elective deferrals and employer contributions to a section 457(b) deferred compensation plan. Optional; absent or 0 means no code G entry. Above 0 it is Form 8880 line 2 (the retirement savings contributions credit, Schedule 3 line 4): the filer's Form 8880 questions are then asked, and box12_g_governmental_plan on this W-2; measured 20% of 2,000 at 25,000 of wages.

box12_g_governmental_plan.description: Form W-2 box 12 code G: whether the section 457(b) plan is a governmental plan. Asked as a gap on every W-2 whose code G amount is above 0 — only a governmental plan's deferrals count toward Form 8880 line 2 (measured: 2,000 of code G gives the credit with true and 0 with false). Refused on a W-2 without a code G amount.

Carried to the engine (Schedule 8812 line 18b unconditionally); above 0 on a filer's W-2 it reaches the combat pay elections — combat_pay_election (Form 1040 line 1i), and with care expenses cdcc_combat_pay_election, with box 10 benefits dependent_care_benefits_combat_pay_election — each asked, never defaulted.

box12_v_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code V — Income from exercise of nonstatutory stock option(s). Optional; absent or 0 means no code V entry. Carried to the engine; it moves no line this service serves at the pin (the DAG agrees).

box12_w_cents.description: Form W-2 box 12, code W — Employer contributions (including employee contributions through a cafeteria plan) to an employee's health savings account (HSA). Optional; absent or 0 means no code W entry. Above 0 it is Form 8889 line 9 and this filer's Form 8889 Part I questions are asked (hsa_medicare first); the amount over the line 8 limit is other income on Schedule 1 line 8z and a 6% excise on Form 5329 (measured: 5,000 self-only moves line 24 from 928.00 to 1,040.00; 3,000 moves nothing).

statutory_employee.description: Form W-2 box 13, the “Statutory employee” checkbox. Asked on every W-2. A checked box is outside what this service computes: the wages belong on Schedule C, and the return is served as knocked out, never as a computed figure.

retirement_plan.description: Form W-2 box 13, the “Retirement plan” checkbox. Asked on every W-2. It reaches the IRA-deduction limit chain; no served line moves on it at this pin because IRA contributions are not asked.

third_party_sick_pay.description: Form W-2 box 13, the “Third-party sick pay” checkbox. Asked on every W-2; nothing in the pinned dictionary reads it, so it moves no line.

has_rrta_codes.description: Form W-2 box 14 — whether it lists Railroad Retirement Tax Act (RRTA) codes (RRTA compensation, Tier 1 or Tier 2 tax). Asked on every W-2. A yes is outside what this service computes: Form 8959 Part III is sized by box-14 RRTA amounts this service does not carry, and the return is served as knocked out, never as a computed figure.

employer_ref.description: Opaque, case-local employer grouping label. W-2s sharing a value came from the SAME employer; different values mean different employers. NOT an employer identifier — no name, EIN, or address, and meaningless outside this request; it is normalised to a dense ordinal before use, so its magnitude never reaches the engine. Required when ONE filer holds more than one W-2, because the excess Social Security credit turns on having had more than one employer and nothing else here can express that.
